scientific_integrity: Exact proof for the 18-vertex Pappus incidence graph, with independent Python and C++17 exhaustive checks. Classification and online dimension are justified mathematically and computationally; full external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Single finite cubic incidence graph only; no extension to other generalized Pappus graphs. Earliest day-verified background anchor is the arXiv first posting 2020-03-11; the inspected 2018 primary paper has no verified day of publication. Historical priority is not certified.
title: Minimum domination reconstructs the Pappus graph and separates static from adaptive shattering
